Listen to “Ho Mubarak Tujhe Humnawa Mil Gaya” from the 1997 Hindi film Ghulam-E-Musthafa, featuring Nana Patekar and Raveena Tandon. With the distinctive vocals of the Sabri Brothers, this memorable track brings together the emotional depth of Hindi film music and the rich, expressive sound of traditional Sufi-inspired singing.

Song: Ho Mubarak Tujhe Humnawa Mil Gaya (Qawwali)
